generic_silhouette.description: Hull sheer and mast plan blur into an indistinct generic sailboat without class-specific profile

scale_ambiguity.description: Missing or contradictory rail, hatch, or gunport sizes make a frigate look like a skiff or vice versa

greeble_spam.description: Tangled spaghetti rigging or random plank noise with no shipwright structural purpose

unclear_propulsion.description: Sails float detached from yards/stays or oar banks intersect the waterline impossibly

form_without_function.description: Superstructure or hull proportions contradict the vessel's declared maritime tradition and role

uniform_material.description: Oak hull planking, pine spars, flax canvas, and iron fittings all share the same plastic sheen

palette_violation.description: Neon or synthetic modern hull colors outside the declared maritime tradition palette

uniform_weathering.description: Random grime distribution instead of waterline fouling, salt spray at the bow, and sun-faded canvas

cropped_subject.description: Maintruck, bowsprit tip, or stern lantern clipped by the frame edge

floating_parts.description: Disjointed masts, impossible hull twist, or unseaworthy waterline trim
